build_protocol_message_class: build a protocol message class at runtime from a Descriptor using GeneratedProtocolMessageType metaclass
serialize_proto_message: serialize a protocol buffer message to a string using SerializeToString and check IsInitialized first
merge_proto_messages: merge one protocol buffer message into another using MergeFrom to combine field values
parse_proto_from_bytes: parse serialized protocol buffer bytes into a message using MergeFromString or FromString static method
inspect_proto_fields: inspect which fields are set in a protocol message using ListFields and HasField methods
